headline: Mark Zuckerberg doesn’t understand how to live
summary: The article critiques Zuckerberg's AI manifesto and vision for life. It suggests his approach to living, particularly with AI, is detached. A personal anecdote about a motivational AI poster highlights the article's skepticism.

headline: Anker’s travel charger works in almost any country and is down to $20
summary: The Anker Nano Travel Adapter is a highly recommended international charger. It supports charging up to five devices simultaneously. Currently, it's on sale for $20, making it a great deal for travelers.

headline: Bluesky now lets you hide reposts from that annoying person you follow
summary: Bluesky has introduced a new feature to hide specific users' reposts. This tool helps declutter your feed from unwanted shared content. It's designed to improve the user experience by giving more control over feed content.

headline: Costco’s great Switch 2 console bundle includes over $100 in free stuff
summary: The Nintendo Switch 2 price is increasing to $499.99 on September 1st, 2026. Costco offers a $499.99 bundle including the Switch 2, a 256GB microSD Express card, and Nintendo Switch Online Expansion Pack. This bundle provides over $100 in free accessories and services for members.

headline: Halloween: The Game Refused Classification in Australia, So It Won’t Be Sold in New Zealand
summary: "Halloween: The Game" has been refused classification in Australia due to rules against illicit drug incentives. This refusal mysteriously impacts its release in New Zealand, despite being a separate country. The developer, Illfonic, has not clarified why it won't adjust content to meet regulations.

headline: AU Deals: Save $100 on a Gigabyte OLED Monitor and get Onimusha: Way of the Sword Free
summary: Australian gamers can save $100 on a Gigabyte OLED Monitor. The deal also includes a free copy of "Onimusha: Way of the Sword". This offers a significant value for those looking for a new gaming monitor.

headline: Get a 36V 500W Adult Electric Bike for $275 Shipped
summary: An adult electric bike, featuring a 36V 500W motor, is on sale for $275, including shipping. The bike can reach speeds up to 23mph and offers a range of up to 45 miles. This deal is part of the AliExpress Back to School Sale.

headline: Fanttik D2 Pocket Green Laser Level Priced Under $30
summary: The Fanttik D2 Pocket Green Laser Level is available for under $30. This tool offers a modern alternative to traditional bubble levels for accurate alignment. It's a convenient and affordable gadget for various tasks.

headline: Amber heat health alerts in place for almost all of England
summary: Amber heat health alerts have been issued across nearly all of England. The alerts will remain in effect until Friday evening. High to extreme temperatures are expected throughout the week as a new heatwave arrives.

headline: Councils to get more powers to stop vape and betting shops
summary: The Prime Minister announced new powers for councils to curb the proliferation of vape and betting shops. The move aims to revitalize town centers, which PM Andy Burnham stated have been "hollowed out." This initiative seeks to address concerns over urban decline and public health.

headline: At least 132 killed in Colombia's largest earthquake in years
summary: Colombia experienced its largest earthquake in years, resulting in at least 132 deaths. Over 480 people were injured across the affected regions. Fears remain that more individuals are trapped under collapsed buildings.

headline: Trump says it would be 'terrible mistake' to remove Infantino
summary: Former US President Donald Trump stated that removing under-pressure FIFA president Gianni Infantino would be a "terrible mistake." Trump's comments come amidst scrutiny and calls for Infantino's ousting. His statement publicly supports the embattled FIFA leader.
